title: jazz.permissions.json
description: An app's permissions for its current schema. Only backends read this file. An absent operation is denied. See https://jazz.tools/docs/reference/app-files

$schema.description: The file's version: this JSON Schema's URL. A newer Jazz may write a later version.

defs.description: Named, parameterised expressions, e.g. "isChatMember($chat)": "exists chatMembers(chatId = $chat, userId = session.user)", called as isChatMember(this.id). Definitions may call each other but never recursively.

tables.description: Each table's policies; every key is a table of jazz.app.json.

read.description: Who may read a row, e.g. "userId = session.user".

insert.description: Which rows may be inserted, checked against the new row.

update.description: A policy checked before and after an update, or { "old": …, "new": … } for each side.

anyOf.description: A policy expression, SQL-like, with single-quoted strings; every policy the engine holds has one. Comparisons: column = | != | < | <= | > | >= value; column in ['a', 'b']; column in session.claims.teams; column contains value; column = null / != null. Values: literals ('text', 42, 1.5, true, false), typed literals (int(5), text('5'), uuid('…'), timestamp(…), array(…), literal(null), …), session.user (the account), session.identity (the exact login), session.identity.subject, session.identity.issuer, session.authMode, session.claims.<path>, $param (inside defs), this.<column> (inside exists: the row being checked). Logic: and, or, not, parentheses, anyOf(…), allOf(…); true / false. Existence: exists <table> [as a](col = value, …), e.g. exists chatMembers(chatId = this.id, userId = session.user); hops: exists files(id = this.fileId).folder(ownerId = session.user); any relation: exists (from t join u as x on t.uId = x.id where x.ownerId = session.user). Inheritance: allowedTo.read(<relation>) / allowedTo.insert / allowedTo.update / allowedTo.delete, or allowedTo.read(via <column>) / allowedTo.read(via <table>.<column>), optionally with maxDepth: 8. Magic columns: $createdBy, $createdBy.account, $createdBy.identity, $updatedBy, $deletedBy, $createdAt, $updatedAt, $deletedAt. Names that are keywords go in backticks: `order`. Definitions: name(arg, …) calls a defs entry. Relations inside exists ( … ), each clause wrapping what comes before: from t [as a], join u as b on a.x = b.y (or left join),  where <predicate>, select a.x as name, …, distinct on (a.x), order by a.x asc | desc, limit n, offset n; sources union(label: query, …) and recursive(seed: query, step: query, frontier: id(row), dedupe: (id(row)), maxDepth: n | fixpoint). In their predicates: outer.<column> and frontier.<column> (the outer and frontier rows), id(row) / id(outer) / id(frontier), param.<name>, json('…') and row(…). Grammar: https://jazz.tools/docs/reference/app-files#expressions
